title: La Constitución de 1917
goal: Read what made Mexico's 1917 Constitution radical for its era -- Article 27 on land and subsoil, Article 123 on labor rights -- and how it differed from earlier liberal constitutions.

items: State who emerged militarily dominant among the revolutionary factions.
Explain what Article 27 established about land and the subsoil.
Describe the labor rights Article 123 guaranteed.
Explain how this constitution differed from earlier liberal constitutions.
